title: Garou Densetsu: CotW - Kim Kaphwan

alternative_titles.ja: 餓狼伝説 CotW｜キム･カッファン｜アニメーショントレーラー

synopsis:
The Kim brothers, Dong Hwan and Jae Hoon, find themselves squaring up with South Town's worst—but they’re in dire straits. Just when it seems all is lost, a ray of hope arrives in the form of their father: legendary taekwondo master Kim Kaphwan. When family bonds and fiery justice collide, evil stands no chance!

(Source: Official YouTube Channel)
